_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: Stirling-PDF
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Stirling-PDF is a web app with dozens of PDF tools: merge, split, rotate, sign, watermark and more. Tools that need LibreOffice, OCR or Ghostscript aren't available. Sign-in is required, with the admin account from the server's settings.
startup: if [ "{{SECURITY_ENABLELOGIN}}" = true ] && [ -z "${SECURITY_INITIALLOGIN_PASSWORD:-}" ] && ! ls configs/stirling-pdf-DB*.mv.db >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Set Admin password in the server's settings first (or turn off Sign-in)."; exit 1; fi; export SERVER_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0 SYSTEM_ENABLEANALYTICS={{SYSTEM_ENABLEANALYTICS}} SYSTEM_ENABLEPOSTHOG={{SYSTEM_ENABLEANALYTICS}} SYSTEM_ENABLESCARF={{SYSTEM_ENABLEANALYTICS}} SYSTEM_SHOWUPDATE={{SYSTEM_SHOWUPDATE}} DISABLE_ADDITIONAL_FEATURES=false; exec java -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=80.0 -Dserver.port={{SERVER_PORT}} -Djava.io.tmpdir=/home/container/.tmp -jar Stirling-PDF.jar

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Stirling-PDF: downloads Stirling-PDF's jar with sign-in (and its web
# interface) from its GitHub releases, checked against GitHub's SHA-256. Settings, users
# and stored files (configs/, customFiles/, pipeline/) are never touched,
# and the jar is only replaced once the new one checks out.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$want" = latest ] || want="v${want#v}"
tag=$(gh-release tag Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF "$want") || fail "Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 3.3.0, then reinstall."

if [ -f Stirling-PDF.jar ] && [ "$(cat .stirling-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "Stirling-PDF $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Stirling-PDF $tag"
    gh-release download Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF "$tag" Stirling-PDF-with-login.jar Stirling-PDF.jar.new
    mv -f Stirling-PDF.jar.new Stirling-PDF.jar
    echo "$tag" > .stirling-version
fi
mkdir -p configs customFiles logs pipeline .tmp
echo "Installed Stirling-PDF $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Stirling-PDF version to install, such as 3.3.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Sign-in
variables.description: Require signing in. Off, anyone who can reach the server can use the tools.

variables.name: Admin username
variables.description: The admin account's username, created at the first start.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The admin account's password, used only at the first start; change it in Stirling-PDF afterwards.

variables.name: Usage reporting
variables.description: Send anonymous usage data to Stirling-PDF's developers.

variables.name: Check for updates
variables.description: Ask GitHub for new releases and show admins a notice when there is one.
